SECTION: DOTC01 §2 — the old daughter object, recomputed from raw FMRT01 bytes

NEW_Y_BIRTHS_BY_THE_DAUGHTER_IN_THE_CAUS.caveat: FMRT01 stored N_Y only every 25 steps, so a birth and a death inside one 25-step gap would be invisible. This is why the organiser question is answered from PQEC01's exact event ledgers and not from FMRT01's sampled series.

WHY_NOT_INVALID: the old object is a real, causally efficacious local X source: FMRT01's GLOBAL_OFF arm produced exactly zero X births in the daughter disc while the SELECTIVE arm produced a median of 110. What it does not carry is an identity that could survive replacement of its material, because it has only one constituent.
